title: Newport Coastal Adventure
specs: Fastest whale watching boats in California, speeds 20-42 mph
Military-grade RHIB boats with high safety standards
Close encounters with whales and dolphins, boats allow leaning over water
Children at least 5 years old on public trips; minimum 3 years on private charters; no passengers under 3 years
No maximum age but boat ride is fast and adventurous
Private charters available for groups up to boat capacity (6, 12, or 19)
Public trips limited to 10-20% less than maximum capacity
includes: Lifejackets on board for each person
gap: Exact prices for general admission tickets not stated
blurb: Guests join fast, small Zodiac boats for whale watching and coastal exploration near Newport Beach. The boats are military-grade RHIBs designed for safety and speed, allowing close encounters with marine wildlife. Trips include private charters and general admission options with limited passenger capacities.
extraNote: No passengers under 3 years old · If trip is too wet due to wind, will return to dock · 309 Palm Street #A Newport Beach, CA 92661 · November through June colder months; July through October warmer months; whale sightings most consistent January through April
